_note: Warning = start of the yellow band, critical = start of the red band. Sources are in knowledge/*.md and knowledge/verification_log.md. basis: nasa = anchored on a NASA number (bands are still TEAM choices), clinical = general medical range, app = defined by the HELM team. Astronaut data is simulated. Not a medical device.

heart_rate.label: Heart rate
heart_rate.source: General adult resting range. NASA gives no universal heart-rate limit; HELM also flags drift from the person's own baseline.

blood_pressure_sys.label: Blood pressure (systolic)
blood_pressure_sys.source: General clinical range, not yet checked against a cited source.

blood_pressure_dia.label: Blood pressure (diastolic)
blood_pressure_dia.source: General clinical range, not yet checked against a cited source.

temperature.label: Body temperature
temperature.source: Fever is commonly defined as 38.0 C or higher. Not from NASA.

blood_sugar.label: Blood sugar
blood_sugar.source: General clinical range, not yet checked against a cited source.

sleep_hours.label: Sleep
sleep_hours.source: Barger et al., Lancet Neurology 2014: NASA schedules 8.5 h, ISS crews averaged 6.09 h. Green 7 h or more, yellow 6 to 7, red under 6 (team bands). Research suggests a 3-night average.

exercise_min.label: Exercise
exercise_min.source: NASA ISS plan of 2.5 h (150 min) per day. Yellow below 80 percent of plan (120 min), red below 50 percent (75 min). Percent bands are team choices.

stress_score.label: Stress (0-100)
stress_score.source: Team-defined, simplified scale. NASA uses POMS and BDI-II. The research notes use a 0-10 scale; this app uses 0-100.

radiation_total_msv.label: Radiation (cumulative)
radiation_total_msv.source: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 Rev C [V1 4030]: career limit 600 mSv. Yellow from 300 (50 percent), red from 480 (80 percent), critical at 600 (team bands).

radiation_event_msv.label: Radiation (single event)
radiation_event_msv.source: Anchors: 19.5 mSv moderate solar event measured by Curiosity RAD; 250 mSv NASA design reference storm [V1 4031]. Yellow from 20, red from 100 (team bands).

co2_mmhg.label: Cabin CO2 (1-hour average)
co2_mmhg.source: Symptoms reported by ISS crew from about 2.3 mmHg; NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 [V2 6004] limit 3.0 mmHg (1-hour average).

o2_partial_pressure_mmhg.label: Cabin O2 partial pressure (kPa)
o2_partial_pressure_mmhg.source: ISS cabin design range 19.5 to 23.1 kPa (NASA NTRS 20120015343). The 1 kPa yellow margin is a team choice. The key name says mmhg but the unit is kPa.
